mapper.select: SELECT fair_id FROM fairs WHERE status = 'PAYMENT_PENDING' AND canceled_at IS NULL AND payment_due_at IS NOT NULL AND payment_due_at <= #{now} ORDER BY payment_due_at, fair_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT fair_id FROM fairs WHERE status = 'PREPARING' AND canceled_at IS NULL AND operation_start_date IS NOT NULL AND operation_start_date <= #{today} ORDER BY operation_start_date, fair_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT fair_id FROM fairs WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND canceled_at IS NULL AND operation_end_date IS NOT NULL AND operation_end_date < #{today} ORDER BY operation_end_date, fair_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT f.fair_id FROM fairs f WHERE f.status = 'PAYMENT_PENDING' AND f.canceled_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.fair_id = f.fair_id AND p.payment_type = 'FAIR_OPENING_FEE' AND p.status = 'COMPLETED' ) ORDER BY f.fair_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE fairs f SET status = 'PREPARING' , updated_at = #{now} WHERE f.fair_id = #{fairId} AND f.status = 'PAYMENT_PENDING' AND f.canceled_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment p WHERE p.fair_id = f.fair_id AND p.payment_type = 'FAIR_OPENING_FEE' AND p.status = 'COMPLETED' )
